state.bit_order: state indices 0..31 are x MSB-to-LSB; 32..63 are y MSB-to-LSB

monomial_prediction_rules.modular_addition: pi_u(x) pi_v(y) reaches pi_w(x+y mod 2^32) iff unsigned integer u+v=w with no overflow
monomial_prediction_rules.bit_model: u_i + v_i + ell_(i+1) - w_i - 2*ell_i = 0, with ell_0=ell_32=0 when indices are written LSB-first
monomial_prediction_rules.anf_coefficient: the coefficient is the number of complete monomial trails modulo 2
